anatomy.treatment: Strong title above the supporting label, aligned to a stable inner edge.
Prominent value with adjacent unit and condition, preserving numeral rhythm.
Consistent crop with a deliberate focal point; no stretched or fabricated imagery.
One clear action, visually distinct from passive badges and metadata.

visual_treatment.surface: Keep a distinct material plane and locally quiet text regions rather than making the entire card uniformly pale.
visual_treatment.edges: Outer curve and media clipping share one corner family; selected edges do not change dimensions.
visual_treatment.elevation: Retain the target depth ladder for separation and feedback; removing all depth is not an anti-slop rule.
visual_treatment.typography: Differentiate title, value, unit and condition; wrapping preserves recognizable object names.
visual_treatment.spacing: Tighter title/label and value/unit groups; larger gaps separate decision, media and action.
visual_treatment.color: Coordinate media with project surfaces; distinguish brand emphasis, selection, action and semantic warning.
visual_treatment.imagery: Target-owned or licensed media with a meaningful crop, never lifted brand artwork.
visual_treatment.motion: Brief reversible feedback without reading-position jumps; preserve clarity under reduced motion.

preserve_character: Keep project energy, material contrast, media presence and hierarchy instead of reducing every card to a thin outline.
coherence_rules: Neighboring cards and tables share type roles, corner family, depth and semantic colors while retaining their different information jobs.

responsive_variants.composition: One readable column with title and condition before supporting media; keep the primary action reachable without overlap.
responsive_variants.access_path: Touch and keyboard reach the same visible action.

responsive_variants.composition: Add columns only when real titles and conditions fit; align actions without truncating meaning.
responsive_variants.access_path: Each card retains a predictable focus order and explicit action.

responsive_variants.composition: Increase readable columns rather than decorative chrome; align comparison-critical summaries across cards.
responsive_variants.access_path: Equivalent keyboard and pointer access; no hidden hover-only action.

interaction_states.hover: Local feedback that does not suggest passive content is clickable.
interaction_states.focus-visible: Unclipped outline around the focused action, distinct from selection.
interaction_states.active: Persistent selection with both visual and semantic indication.
interaction_states.disabled: Readable content and a clear reason the action is unavailable.

intermediate_width_behavior: Change column count when content requires it; test just before and after the transition and under text zoom, keeping readable type, focal crops and nonoverlapping actions.
